changelog:
- Initial release of training certificate lifecycle management skill.
- Supports certificate template design, generation, issuance, validation (with QR code/serial number), renewal/upgrade, revocation, and reissue workflows.
- Manages certificate status transitions, template configurations, and full record-keeping for trainees and certificates.
- Enables electronic and physical certificate distribution, signature confirmation, and comprehensive verification services.
- Provides structured data model for efficient tracking of certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, and delivery.
summary: 培训证书全生命周期管理：证书模板设计、证书生成（含编号/学员信息/培训内容/成绩）、证书发放与签收确认、证书查询验证（二维码/编号）、证书续期/升级管理、证书作废与补办流程。
